Satellite name ALEASAT
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher not launched
Entity name University of British Columbia
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Nation Canada
Partners Simon Fraser University
Oneliner

Picture the earth and investigate the physiological effects of long-term human spaceflight.
Notes

The project is a 50/50 split between the "SFU Satellite Design Team" and the "UBC Orbit Satellite Design Team." Although RF licensed by UBC for the purposes of using a single legal entity the satellite is jointly owned and operated by the student teams.

Selected by ESA for 4th “Fly Your Satellite!" in 2024.
